title: Move "Calculating Delta-values" tutorial to sphinx-gallery examples
body:
Move "Calculating Delta-values tutorial" to examples/deltacodesdft sphinx gallery (See issues: #1794, #1756 )

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body: When do these files appear? At build-time I think they go somewhere else?

comments.body: For me at build time these files appear in `examples/deltacodesdft`.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: I pushed a small update so we ignore all PNGs.  (We already ignore .traj so I removed that line)

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body: I see, at build time lots of output files are generated under the examples. It would be nice if they could be actually deleted with `make clean` (or `make clean-tutorials` that doesn't delete images from main docs?) rather than simply ignored. But perhaps that can wait until the dust has settled on the tutorial paths/arrangement.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment raises a question about when files appear and where they go at build-time, implying the .gitignore entry may be incorrect or misplaced — a potential issue that should be addressed.

comments.author: askhl

comments.label_reasoning: The comment explicitly recommends using a context manager (`with` statement) for Trajectory to ensure safe/proper file handling and avoid resource leaks.

comments.author: elisabeth.keller
comments.body: I think you already did that in 792dd2d3.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Explicitly requests a code change: use a 'with' statement for safe file handling.

comments.body:
I'll go ahead and merge this.  If there are other things, maybe we can deal with them in a separate MR.  There are probably a few *general* things for sphinx gallery that we should deal with at the level of many tutorials (gitignore stuff, linting, better plotting shortcuts, datafile generation and handling, and what do I know).

Thanks a lot @elisabeth.keller!
